title: the WSG special weather - the hurricane, tornado and hailstorm tables
audit_label: R429 WSG special weather pin audit
audit_comment: The special weather data slice pins Tables 6, 7 and 8 (rules/wsgsplwx.h, prefix wsw): the hurricane half-point grid, the tornado none/damaged/destroyed codes and the hailstorm dice, verified cell for cell with the dash censuses and the printed prose; census 353 -> 354.

banner.title: The WSG SPECIAL WEATHER, R429: the data slice of the special-weather section - Table 6 (the hurricane damage to structures), Table 7 (the tornado damage to structures) and Table 8 (the hailstorm damage to characters) with the hurricane, gale, tornado and sandstorm prose pins.
banner.provenance: Provenance: the WSG scan (archive.org item pdfy-B3Fz83tZ3TV7zOc8), printed pp. 23-24; the three grids read from the IIIF page images and verified against the text layer and the letter-code and dice prose.
banner.sentinel: Sentinel: 0 = a dash cell. Table 6 damage doubles to half-points (1 = 1/2 point, 2 = 1 point); Table 7 codes 0, 1, 2 = none, damaged, destroyed; Table 8 cells are the 1dN die size with 0 = no damage.

examples.note: the Table 6 doubling: light wood 1 point = 2 half-points, light earth and normal soft stone are both 1/2 = 1
the heavy row: wood 3 points = 6, earth 2 = 4, hard rock 1 = 2
the Table 7 ladder: light wooden damaged on 1-2, destroyed on 3-6; wood and stone dash-dash-D-D-D-X
examples.expr: m['wswTornadoRoll1'](0) != 1 or m['wswTornadoRoll3'](0) != 2 or m['wswTornadoRoll2'](3) != 0 or m['wswTornadoRoll6'](3) != 2

examples.note: heavy stone: dashes on 1-4, damaged on 5-6
the Table 8 dice: no armor takes 1d4/1d6/1d8, scale or chain mail is safe in small hail
the hailstone dispatch: a 1/2 inch stone is small, a 1 1/2 inch stone is medium, a 2 inch stone is large
the hurricane wind stages: light 80+, normal 100-140, heavy up to 200; the gale tops out below at 79

prev_record: pushed 435aaac..9723174), the WSG environment data slice, printed pp. 21-22
- Table 4 (the 13 temperature bands, the str/dex/con, land-move num/den and
attack columns, 99 = no effect) and Table 5 (the 6 wind bands 0-10 to 80+,
the missile/melee and move num/den columns, 99 = xx impossible), the
how-to-use prose pins (the 2-turn strenuous window, the ex-str caps 18/17,
fractions round up, the damage floor 1, the greater of the two move
reductions, perpendicular one band lower) and the precipitation shifts
(moderate +1 band, heavy +2, capped at the bottom 80+ line).
rules/wsgenvfx.h NEW (38 inlines, prefix wse), verified cell for cell
three-way (the page image vs the text layer vs the book own examples: 105
deg band 10, -30 LM 1/2, 35 mph melee -2, 85/40 the greater reduction 2/3,
the 90-mph cap). tools/wsg_gap_report.md flips 5: post-state 16 closed, 170
open, 42 tables. Lessons: the 99 census was initialized to the expected
values and then incremented - now zeros plus a separate expected array; the
precip cap check band(90)+2 != 5 was TRUE on correct data and would have
shipped bad 1 - now band(90) == 5 with the raw shift 5+2 = 7; the no-split
gate caught 10 splits in the first build. Census 352 -> 353.
